title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. A male and female fell in love with each other and they wanted to marry each other. In start, they used to say each other as to-be husband and to-be wife. With passage of time, there intensity of love kept increasing. At a stage, it happened they started saying each other wife and husband, and their conversation converted to the way as under: Male: Do you agree that you are my wife? Female: Yea, from depths of my heart and soul. and like: Female: Who am I to you? Male: You are my Wife. This continued for long, here are questions that: Wether have the become husband and wife according to Sharia'a by saying this all to each other? If answer is yes to first question, what will be the status of a Nikah of the female with anyother male? 4061 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 10144 Country: Pakistan Title: AOA SIR: I want to discuss vd u my problam. kindly reply vd valid proof. my husband is enforcing me to do that. my issue is: 1. can i kiss my husband's penis, not directly. if penis is covered by something like condom or any thing else.and also vice versa, can my husbad indirectly kiss vegina. plz tell me is there is any way through which we can kiss each other's private part. thanx Question: AOA SIR: I want to discuss vd u my problam. kindly reply vd valid proof. my husband is enforcing me to do that. my issue is: 1. can i kiss my husband's penis, not directly. if penis is covered by something like condom or any thing else.and also vice versa, can my husbad indirectly kiss vegina. plz tell me is there is any way through which we can kiss each other's private part. thanx Answer ID: 10144 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 119/88=H/1429) There is no sin if it happened sometimes due to excessive lust, but it is makrooh (undesirable) to force or make it a habit, as it is mentioned in Fatawa Aalamgiriyah, Bab Al-Karahiyah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
